reason: The first counted collab is free, so I'd try that and see if the café owner even bothers asking customers for the coupon. I'm not paying for Auto-DM and unlimited posts when I do maybe one or two barter collabs a month and I'm already applying through Influish.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. A 'customers I brought' record only matters if the next business actually looks at it and pays cash because of it, and at 5K followers I'm not sure my numbers will impress anyone.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a nano creator like me in Bengaluru who used their counted record to get a paid collab instead of a free meal.
